Некоторые префиксы, например лично-числовые показатели 1-го и 2-го лица, по-видимому, сдвигают ударение влево, например s-é-ḳwe ‘я иду’ (1SG.ABS-DYN-идти), но ma-ḳwé (DYN-идти) ‘он идет’ ... sources.quote: Stress 'is confined to a two-syllable window at the right edge of the prosodic word in Circassian languages'; 'Most reliable is the attraction of stress by final closed syllables, a pattern described for literary Adyghe (Rogava & Kerasheva 1966), the Abzekh variety of Adyghe spoken in Turkey (Paris 1989)'; 'In literary Adyghe, there also are lexical items with a light final stressed syllable, a pattern reported to be the most common one by Rogava & Kerasheva (1966), e.g. mɐˈlə, dəˈdə, ʦəˈzɐ'; R&K's data 'suggest weight-sensitivity for words containing the low vowel /a/ in the penult ... k’aˈlɐ

sources.note: Most recent specialist synthesis of Circassian stress incl. literary/Abzekh/Hatkoy Adyghe; frames the morphological effects as prosodic-word extraprosodicity within a quantity-sensitive two-syllable window — should be added as a cited corroborating source for the weight and domain fields.
